welcome.purpose: Learn important traffic safety rules and road skills.
welcome.how: Tap on the activities to practice safe walking and crossing streets.
welcome.goal: Become confident and safe around traffic and roads.
welcome.intro: Learn about traffic safety with interactive exercises.

activities.traffic-lights-desc: Learn when to stop, wait, and go
activities.vehicles-desc: Learn about cars, buses, and other vehicles

traffic-lights.title: Traffic Lights
traffic-lights.tap-light: Tap the light to change it

crosswalk.title: Crosswalk
crosswalk.how-title: How to cross the street safely:

road-signs.title: Road Signs
road-signs.stop-description: Come to a complete stop before the stop line. Continue only when it is safe.
road-signs.crosswalk-description: Give way to pedestrians on or about to enter the crosswalk.
road-signs.warning-description: This warning sign means you should pay extra attention to a hazard on the road.
road-signs.bicycle-path-description: Mandatory cycle path. Bicycles must use this path.
road-signs.children-warning-description: Warning: children may suddenly enter or be near the road.
road-signs.speed-limit-description: The maximum permitted speed is 30 kilometres per hour.

safe-places.title: Safe Places
safe-places.drag-to-sort: Drag items to SAFE or DANGEROUS zones
safe-places.intro-title: Learn to tell safe places from dangerous places
safe-places.intro-before: In this game you will see different places. Your task is to decide if the place is
safe-places.intro-after: for children to play or walk.
safe-places.question: Is this place safe for children?
safe-places.result-perfect: Perfect! You really know which places are safe!
safe-places.result-excellent: Very good! You understand traffic safety well!
safe-places.result-good: Good job! Practice a little more and you will get even better!
safe-places.result-practice: Keep practicing! Remember that sidewalks and playgrounds are safe.

speak.start: Look at the picture and decide if it is a safe place or a dangerous place.
speak.game_over: The game is over. You got {score} out of {total}.
speak.won: Congratulations! You finished the game with {score} out of {total}!

sidewalk.name: Sidewalk
sidewalk.description: A sidewalk next to the road
sidewalk.explanation: The sidewalk is safe for pedestrians. It is separate from the road and cars do not drive here.

road.name: Road
road.description: In the middle of a road
road.explanation: The road is dangerous for pedestrians. Cars drive here and you can be hit.

parking.name: Parking lot
parking.explanation: Parking lots are dangerous. Cars move around and drivers do not always see pedestrians.

playground.name: Playground
playground.description: A fenced playground in the park
playground.explanation: The playground is safe. It is fenced in and cars are not allowed here.

crosswalk.name: Crosswalk
crosswalk.explanation: The crosswalk is safe when the light is green and you look both ways.

highway.name: Highway
highway.explanation: The highway is very dangerous. Cars drive very fast and pedestrians are not allowed here.

school-zone.name: School zone
school-zone.description: Outside a school with a crosswalk
school-zone.explanation: School zones are safe. Cars must drive slowly here and there are crosswalks.

construction.name: Construction site
construction.explanation: Construction sites are dangerous. Big machines and trucks work here.

reflectors.title: Reflectors & Visibility
reflectors.can-you-see: Can you see in the dark?
reflectors.why-text: Reflectors help you be seen in the dark. When car headlights hit reflectors, they light up and make you visible to drivers from far away.
reflectors.dress-btn-desc: Drag reflectors to the right place
reflectors.compare-title: Visibility by day and by night
reflectors.visibility-good-desc: You are clearly visible in daylight
reflectors.visibility-excellent-desc: Reflectors make you visible from 200 m away!
reflectors.visibility-poor-desc: Without reflectors you can only be seen from 20-30 m away
reflectors.complete: Fantastic! Now the person is much easier to see in the dark!
tips: Reflectors make you visible up to 200 meters away
Always wear reflectors when you walk outside in the dark
Put reflectors on both the front and the back
Reflectors work best on moving parts like arms and legs
Wash reflectors gently so they keep working

speak.compare: Compare how visible a person is during the day and at night
speak.dress_up: Dress the person with reflectors so they can be seen better in the dark
speak.done: Perfect! Now the person is much easier to see in the dark. Reflectors save lives!
